130 calls (levels he watched, no trade) are not copied.

His positions (often $40k+) are scaled to $1,000 a trade, split by his share counts.
Prices are 1-minute market bars, not his own fills.
Costs are estimates: 5 bps per side, 20 under $10.
Just holding SPY leaves out its dividends (about 1% a year).
Worst drop counts closed trades only, not open ones.
